youtube.title: Pencil mein chhah side hi kyun hote hain? ✏️ #Shorts
youtube.description:
Zyadatar pencil mein chhah flat side hoti hain. Gol pencil simple lagti hai, lekin dhalan wali desk par woh ludhak kar gir jati hai. Flat side usse rokti hain aur ungliyon ko grip bhi deti hain.

Chhah side ka ek aur fayda hai: factory ek hi lakdi ke slab se zyada pencil kaat sakti hai, kam waste ke saath. Ab apni desk ki pencil dekho.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
